text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bathed in the dappled sunlight filtering through the mountain trees... ahhh!
This is truly a setting worthy for the opening of an operetta!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...*sigh*.
Seriously, how did it come to this—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ayabe-san!
Wouldst thou accompany me for some astronomical observation?!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Out of nowhere? What's this about?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: The truth is, I have recently decreed that a puppet show by myself and for myself shall soon commence!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
However, alas... there is no music to make the puppets dance!!
Thus, as inspiration for my composition—
I wish to borrow starlight. The energy held by celestial bodies!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Do you not frequently venture into the mountains in pursuit of stars?
Therefore, be my guide!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
N-Now don't say that!
Let's hear her out. Okay?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Top Road-san, I think
you're far too soft on Opera O.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
No, that's not true! If anything, Ayabe-san,
you're the one who always goes along with her in the end—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, huh? Come to think of it...
Where did Opera O-chan go?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
H-Help me, Top Road-san...!!
It's no use, I cannot move... Ahh—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
How breathtaking I am, reflected in this mountain stream!!
A form that would make even Hermes envious—I simply cannot look away!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Umm... Y-Yes, quite!
Still, it'll be dangerous once the sun sets,
so shall we get going soon...?!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oh? If I were to pose over there,
that bridge would make quite the picturesque scene... —Very well.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...The summit isn't that way.
That's just a detour.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... allow me to enlighten you, Ayabe-san!
At times like this, there is only one path to take.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Whichever path makes my heart dance—
THAT is the supreme sovereign way! Haaah-hah-hah-hah!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Hey.
Can't we just leave that thing behind?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
—Magnificent. So this is the vista from the summit.
A Grand Opéra spun and sung by the stars themselves!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah... before this sky full of stars, my creative spirit swells!
It surges forth! My own genius terrifies me!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...I just have one question.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Knowing you, wouldn't you find inspiration anywhere?
Claiming every single place is befitting of you, or something.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, true enough. After all, look who I am!
Even inside my dorm room, it would hardly be impossible.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: However—I simply refuse to tolerate compromise.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Climbing the mountain together with comrades, overcoming hardships—
and seizing this scenery. I have bestowed a drama upon this night sky!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Only then can one feel true emotion, and poetic verses surge!
—And that is precisely what I desired!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Now then. Since we have conquered this mountain—
which one shall we scale next!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Next...?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I require about five more pieces to raise the curtain!
—Let us meet tomorrow in front of the school gates at 16:00!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Good grief, you really are something else...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Just this once. There won't be a second time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One morning, I happened across Admire Vega and
the others looking visibly exhausted.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ah, hahaha... We did quite a bit of mountain climbing,
so I suppose that's why...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...After dragging us through all that trouble,
if you don't make it a success, I won't forgive you.
